_README: THE AFFILIATE SLOT LAYER. One file, one edit. To monetise a provider: put the tracked link in `url` and set `affiliate` to true. The site then shows the disclosure banner, marks that row `ad` and adds rel=sponsored nofollow. Nothing else in the repo changes. Every link is plain and untracked until a real programme is actually joined.
_disclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you sign up through one, this site may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. It cannot change the prices below - every price is pulled live from the provider's own public API by open-source code you can read and run.

Vultr.programme: Vultr Affiliate Program - CASH. One-time bounty, roughly $10-$100 per qualified sale depending on plan, 30-day cookie, paid monthly by PayPal, $100 minimum payout. Free to join, no minimum sales, but the application is reviewed.
Vultr.status: NOT JOINED - application form requires a browser session

Akamai (Linode).programme: Akamai Cloud Referral Program - CREDIT ONLY, not cash. Give $100 / get $25 in account credit once the referred account spends $25 and stays active 90 days. The referral link also has to be activated by spending $25 of your own money first.
Akamai (Linode).status: WILL NOT JOIN - pays no cash, and activating it would require spending money we do not have

Scaleway.programme: No self-serve affiliate programme. Scaleway runs a reseller/technology partner track, not a public affiliate scheme - there is an open customer feature request asking them to create one.

AWS Lightsail.programme: No consumer affiliate programme for Lightsail.
AWS Lightsail.status: NOT MONETISABLE - listed for comparison honesty, will never be a paid slot
